observation.setting: Indoor dance studio with wooden floor, mirrors on the back wall, and an audience seated along the side and back.
observation.dancers: One couple: a man in a grey suit and a woman in a dark red dress with a high side slit and heels.
observation.formation_and_space: A single couple dancing in close embrace, moving around the center of the wooden dance floor.
observation.posture: Torso upright, slight lean forward into the embrace, knees slightly flexed, weight shifting between feet.

observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains connected in embrace; hips rotate naturally with steps and turns.
observation.partnering: Close embrace partnering with constant upper-body contact and lead-and-follow dynamics.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low to medium level, pivots, and turns; no jumps.
observation.costume_and_props: Man wears a grey suit with tie; woman wears a dark red sleeveless dress with a high leg slit and high-heeled dance shoes.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and precise weight transfer timing cannot be determined due to low resolution and sampling rate.

signature_moments.what: Woman executes a fluid boleo (leg sweep) circling behind while maintaining upper-body embrace connection with the man.
Couple performs a synchronized turn with the woman's leg extended outward around the man's leg.
Couple pauses in close embrace with a dip, woman's leg uncurling low to the floor.
